title: Relief board
description: Porcelain columns rise around a selected point on an ultramarine isometric field.
useCase: Show a local influence radius through a legible three-dimensional surface.
interaction: Move across the field or select a point.
reducedMotion: Column positions update immediately; keyboard selection stays instant.
limitations: A bounded seven-by-seven SVG height field; no physical collision engine or arbitrary terrain data.
look: Saturated ultramarine field with a seven-by-seven isometric grid of off-white columns, one yellow top marked with a cross, and tiny letter-spaced corner captions.
motion: Columns rise in a Gaussian mound centred on the mouse-hovered or selected point, each easing out to its new height over 300 ms; keyboard selection updates instantly.
adapt: Column height is `10 + Math.exp((-d * d) / 4.4) * 65`, with `d` measured from `focus` (hover, else `selected`); the rise is the `rb-column` transition `transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`. Tune falloff and amplitude there; replace the footer readout and point labels.
